clips.title: The story
paras: Hearts of the Pure is a sinister warlock trial assigned in the Undercity by Godrick Farsan on behalf of Carendin Halgar. In order to prepare the ritual bait needed to bind a succubus, an aspiring summoner must hunt down and butcher two uniquely righteous human men. Their pure hearts serve as an irresistible temptation for the demonic temptress awaiting summoning.

Binding a succubus requires an understanding of temptation that cuts both ways. While the Nether's sirens prey upon desire and ruin, nothing draws them out of the Twisting Nether quite like untainted virtue ripe for corruption. Within the Temple of the Damned, master summoner Carendin Halgar delegates the groundwork to Godrick Farsan, who scours human lands for souls whose goodness remains pristine and unbroken.

Farsan identifies two distinct paragons of virtue. The first is Dalin Forgewright, an honorable man attending to desperate Lordaeron refugees barred from sanctuary outside the sealed Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine. The second is Comar Villard, a faithful husband tirelessly searching the perilous marshlands of the Wetlands for any trace of his lost wife. To a Forsaken warlock, their devotion, empathy, and loyalty make them prime sacrifices.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Men of honor and goodness? Does such a man exist?
It took much research, but through bits of overheard stories, I managed to find two men that should do.
The first is Dalin Forgewright, who has dedicated himself to the care of the Lordaeron refugees, whom are refused by their kin at the Greymane Wall.
The other is Comar Villard, a man who remains faithful to his lost love, wandering the Wetlands for a sign of his wife.
Deliver their hearts to Carendin. But first, let me show you your quarry.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have been pleasantly surprised by the speed of your progress so far, friend. Bring me the hearts and you will impress me once again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heart of a goodly man seems much the same as any, when you see it like this, don't you think?
Perhaps we possess something of a... Different... View on the subject. These will do, though. I have no doubt that a succubus would be attracted by their purity.
